proposed.text: How do the LEA passing rule and the Board's CPD authority fit together in the checked RA 9266 IRR?

options.text: Section 15 sets the LEA passing thresholds, while Section 7 authorizes the Board to adopt CPD guidelines; these are separate competence controls.
CPD replaces the LEA passing standard for first registration.
The LEA has no minimum subject-grade requirement if CPD is completed.
CPD is the same as the post-exam oath requirement.
